name: Holiday Planetarium Lighting
cost: Pay as you may admission; show tickets $5
paras: The South Carolina State Museum stays open late to light up its planetarium dome for the holidays. Guests can meet Santa, hear live music from ColaJazz and make a holiday craft for kids.
General admission is pay as you may that evening, so families choose their own price. Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer 4D and the Aróra planetarium show are $5 each, and food trucks sell dinner.
tip: Pick your show times early, since the host lists Rudolph 4D from 4 PM and Aróra from 4:30 PM.

name: Sundaes with Santa at the Junior League Holiday Market
venue: South Carolina State Fairgrounds, Goodman and Cantey buildings
paras: The Junior League of Columbia adds Sundaes with Santa to its 40th annual Holiday Market on the final market day. Kids take a photo with Santa in front of the market's Christmas tree, then play holiday games, do crafts and write a letter to Santa.
The visit ends at an ice cream sundae bar. Photos with Santa are free, but families bring their own camera since no photographer is on site.
tip: Bring your own camera and plan for $5 parking at Gate 6, as the host lists.

name: Irmo Tree Lighting
paras: The Town of Irmo lights its tree at Whitt Cline Community Park with local school choirs and bands and a greeting from the mayor. After the countdown, the crowd gets pizza, hot chocolate and cookies.
Santa arrives by fire truck so children can share their Christmas wishes, according to the town.
tip: Arrive before 6 PM to hear the school choirs before the countdown.

name: Snowball Festival Carnival
paras: The Icehouse Amphitheater hosts a free Snowball Festival Carnival on Saturday with rides, pictures with Santa, face painting, balloon animals and a petting zoo. The venue also lists holiday mini golf, a Lexington County Public Library table and free cookies.
Vendors on the page include Tally Ho Mobile Petting Zoo, Carolina Holiday Mini Golf, Balloonopolis and Palmetto Amusements. The venue says outside food and drink are not permitted.
tip: Skip the lawn chairs, since the amphitheater does not allow freestanding chairs.

name: Family Palooza: Santa Visit at Gaston Library
paras: Lexington County Public Library invites families with children to meet Santa at the Gaston Branch. Kids share their wish list and snap a festive photo.
The event is part of the library's Family Palooza holiday series and runs one hour on a Wednesday evening.
tip: Bring a camera, since the host encourages a festive photo with Santa.
